Investigate each step and component of the Kalman Filter. The measurement model is the identity
(**C = I**), so measurements can be depicted in the state space. A variety of dynamic models are
available in the dropdown menu. Control is omitted for simplicity (**B = 0**).

**Solid** outlines and **filled** dots are things you can change; **dashed** outlines and **hollow**
dots are derived by the filter. Drag a square handle to reshape a covariance, hover anything to see
what it is, drag empty space to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. The **stage** buttons highlight the
predict or update step you are looking at, and the legend entries below the plot toggle any entity
on its own. Every ellipse is a 1σ contour.
